source_title: Dyson Promo Codes: 25% Off in October 2026
source_excerpt:
If you’re hunting for a new vacuum, Dyson has likely come up in one way or another. The brand is famous for its powerful vacuum cleaners , but its air power also extends to other parts of the home, including hair care and air purification. It’s a dream household staple; I lugged around an old Dyson vacuum for years until I could upgrade to a newer stick model rather than buying something that wouldn’t be as powerful or last as long.
But the cost can make it a hard investment, even if it’s worth it. If you’re shopping for one of Dyson’s long-lasting gadgets but have a limited budget, fear not: we’ve got coupon codes to make it a better buy, plus tips on how to get discounts on Dyson’s website. Read on to get all of our Dyson promo codes and coupons, and learn the best ways to shop for a Dyson.
Get a 15% Off Dyson Promo Code When You Register
Usually, you need to be a new customer to get a great discount, but Dyson rewards you for being a repeat customer. You can get 15% off your next order by registering your current Dyson product’s serial number .
Sign Up to Unlock a 10% Off Dyson Coupon Code
You can also get 10 percent off your next Dyson purchase without needing a device to register. You’ll want to sign up your mobile number via a pop-up on Dyson’s homepage . That will send you a text, and you’ll have to reply with “Y” to officially register. After you reply, you’ll receive a message with a link that reveals a single-use code for 10 percent off your next purchase at Dyson.
You can also sign up for texts or Dyson’s email newsletters (like this hair care newsletter) to access exclusive Dyson sale events, more coupon codes, and new product releases (and several new vacuums are due out this year).
Save up to $600 With This Week’s Dyson Coupons
Dyson always has sales on its website at the Dyson Deals Hub . The discounts rotate weekly, and there are always different active coupons across different categories of Dyson products. You might find a nice discount on the V12 vacuum , for instance, or on the Dyson Airstrait .
Keep Cool for Less: $130 Off the Dyson Cool CF1
Summer’s in full effect, and the sun just keeps blazing. The Dyson Cool CF1 is the high-tech, clean-air solution you’ve been looking for. Powered by Dyson’s Air Multiplier technology, this sleek fan delivers quiet, powerful cooling, including sleep mode. Usually $380, it’s $130 off, now only $250—a sweet deal for summer. Dyson’s known for sleek, futuristic designs, and this fan is no different. It has no blades, which means no choppy airflow, dust buildup, or hassling with potentially dangerous blades while cleaning. The annular aperture accelerates air, drawing in surrounding air to project smooth, uninterrupted airflow. The model is also energy-efficient and offers a wide range of oscillation angles and manual tilt for precise cooling wherever you are.
Looking for a bigger discount? Try Dyson’s outlet for refurbished vacuums, hair tools, and air purifiers. You’ll find discounts of up to 30 percent off the original price, and each one is inspected, restored to like-new condition, and backed by Dyson’s official warranty. It’s a good way to get great deals on products like the Supersonic hair dryers, which you can find for under $200 when refurbished, and Dyson’s multi-stylers can be found for under $300. These do have a shorter warranty period than new products, though; it’ll only be six months to a year rather than two to five years.
During the Dyson Owner Rewards event, Dyson owners receiv e 20% off Dyson technology purchases. When you choose one of the qualifying floorcare or air purifiers , you’ll enter your one-time-use code at the payment section when you check out online at Dyson. Or, if you’d prefer, you can simply log in and your Dyson discount will automatically be applied at checkout. You can also shop at your nearest Dyson Demo Store or make a purchase over the phone. If you don’t have a Dyson discount code automatically applied, you can register your machine by calling 1-866-693-9766 to speak with a Dyson expert about Owner Rewards.
If you’re looking to invest in this often pricey, long-lasting technology, I’d suggest checking the Dyson deals page, where you can see all the exclusive rotating Dyson offers available right now and shop by category, like cordless vacuums, hair care, air treatment, headphones, and more. Some of the best deals I’ve seen so far include the viral Dyson Airwrap Origin multi-styler and dryer , which has three attachments and is $150 off right now, and the V12 Detect Slim, a highly-rated cordless Dyson vacuum with 60 minutes of run time for $250 off.
Like all of Dyson’s tech lineup, Dyson hair tools have the signature high power, efficiency, sleek design, … and high price tag. One of Dyson’s most iconic and enduring tools is the Dyson Airwrap, which debuted in 2018. We rated it a 9/10 WIRED Recommends for its multifunctionality, offerings for different hair types, less heat use than previous models, and a light, easy-to-use design.
When it comes to hair gadgets, there are many gimmicks that claim to make styling easy and effortless, but the Dyson Airwrap actually works, using air to draw strands of your hair around the curling barrels to produce a lasting result without subjecting your hair to excessive damaging heat. It's a multifunction styler, but the Airwrap really shines as a curling iron. Powered by its internal motor, it creates a vortex of air inside the hollow barrel, powerful enough to draw your hair to it. All you have to do is place the end of your hair near the barrel, and the machine does the gripping and wrapping for you, so you don't have to worry about touching a hot curling barrel.
I’m of the opinion that everyone needs an air purifier and a fan . So why not combine both? (Especially if you are short on space, like me.) We at WIRED love the Dyson Purifier Cool PC2, which works in tandem to cool the air with purified air. Not only does it function as a fan, blowing cool air, but it also captures gases and 99% of pollutants, redistributing cool, purified air throughout your home for a healthier living space. It also conveniently connects to the MyDyson app for hands-free control anywhere, and it’s $100 off right now.
If you’re looking to invest in this often pricey, long-lasting technology, I’d suggest checking out the Dyson deals page, where you can see all the exclusive rotating Dyson offers available right now and shop by category, such as cordless vacuums, hair care, air treatment, headphones, and more.
Special Dyson Offer: Dyson OnTrac $250 Off
As mentioned above, Dyson has a dedicated deals page , making it easier than ever to find what you’re looking for and save. This includes Dyson’s new OnTrac noise-canceling headphones , now half off at $250. They offer best-in-class noise cancellation, up to 55 hours of battery life, and an ergonomic design for enhanced comfort. Plus, you can mix and match with Dyson’s 360° visualizer before buying to truly customize these noise-canceling headphones .
